description: The IERS reference routine interp.f run on the EOP 20 C04 series sampled at 0h UTC. LAGINT is its 4-point Lagrange interpolation of x, y and UT1-UTC, which the gem's default should reproduce. PMUT1_OCEANS gives the diurnal and semi-diurnal ocean tide terms on x, y and UT1, PM_GRAVI the diurnal libration terms on x and y; interp.f adds both to the LAGINT values, and the gem leaves them out. The cases are 8 epochs per day, every 317 days from MJD 45702, moved forward past any day whose window spans a leap second since interp.f interpolates UT1-UTC across the step. Each case lists x ("), y (") and UT1-UTC (s) from LAGINT, the ocean tide corrections in the same units, and the libration corrections on x and y. Statistics are in microarcseconds and microseconds.

c04_0h.title: EOP (IERS) 20 C04 TIME SERIES consistent with ITRF 2020 - sampled at 0h UTC
